newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin urges countrymen to buy Russian goods.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin urges countrymen to buy Russian goods.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin called on Russians on Tuesday to buy Russian goods to help the economy, praising the quality of domestic manufacturers.
"When we buy domestic goods, we help our country, our Russian industry, we help ourselves," he said in a pre-recorded radio broadcast. "This is the sort of patriotism I like."

Yeltsin, who has taken to using radio addresses to speak to the population on a variety of issues, said his "Buy Russian" campaign would help the economy, which officials say is on the point of resuming growth after seven years of severe recession.

"Do you want fewer unemployed? Do you want to help Russian enterprises? Do you want us to stand on our own feet and work at full strength? Then I say to you, buy our goods, our Russian goods, and you won't regret it," he said.
But Yeltsin, speaking in a firm, clear voice, said the government would not use administrative means to limit imports and help domestic goods.
"There must be fair competition in Russia," he said.
